module: Utility functions for the career interface: status bar data (money, beamXP, vouchers, insurance score), simple per-branch statistics, contextual buttons of the career pause menu, and current level (map). Called by the Vue components (CareerStatus, CareerSimpleStats, pause menu).
notes: The pause buttons are stored by index (functionId) in a local table; callCareerPauseContextButtons(functionId) then calls the corresponding function. Each call to getCareerPauseContextButtons rebuilds and replaces this table.

Possible buttons: map (or "my cargo" in delivery mode), logbook, progress and milestones page (only outside the tutorial and after buying the starter vehicle), certification cancellation, test drive cancellation.

getCareerStatusData.desc: Data for the CareerStatus Vue component: money, beamXP, vouchers and insurance driving score.

getCareerSimpleStats.desc: Data for the CareerSimpleStats Vue component: save name and, for each non-skill branch, name, level label, value and min/max bounds of the level.

storeCareerPauseContextButtons.desc: Stores the pause button functions and assigns each a functionId (index); clears the old table.

data.desc: Table with buttons (list of {label, icon, fun, showIndicator}); each button receives functionId.

callCareerPauseContextButtons.desc: Runs the pause button function with index functionId, if it exists.

getCareerPauseContextButtons.desc: Builds the list of contextual buttons of the career pause menu (depending on delivery, tutorial, certification, test drive) and stores them.

getCareerCurrentLevelName.desc: Returns the core_levels.getList() entry matching the loaded level (lowercase comparison with getCurrentLevelIdentifier()).

returns.desc: Level info, nil if not found.
